scope: typed entity and relation attribute columns in CLTR type 4 payload version 2

checks.round_trip: preserve categorical and binary64 values, explicit missing values, units, bounds and declared resolution
checks.independent: read a Python-authored two-entity, one-relation fixture with three attribute columns; inspect exact slot values and unchanged topology diagnostics
checks.rejection: reject malformed schemas, schema/version mismatches, wrong payload lengths, invalid presence codes, missing required values, unknown categories, and out-of-range or nonfinite reals
checks.compatibility: preserve all earlier version 1 fixture bytes and diagnostics; version 2 is required so older readers cannot silently discard attributes
checks.install: run existing release, sanitizer and substrate-free conformance on all three supported hosts

limits: attribute preservation and validation only; resolution is a declaration and attributes do not enter tier-0 diagnostics
